name: Vulture Deck
tagline: Point the drone. We'll tell you what's broken before it bites you.
positioning: Automated drone inspection reports for people who own one drone, one roof, and zero patience for a $600 rope-access invoice.

hero.h1: Fly it once. Get a report a structural engineer won't laugh at.
hero.sub: Upload your drone footage. Vulture Deck stitches it, flags the cracks, rust, and missing shingles, and spits out a PDF you can hand to insurance without a translator.

features.title: Auto-Flag Everything Ugly
features.description: Our models circle the corrosion, delamination, and cracked flashing so you don't squint at 4,000 frames pretending you know what fascia is.

features.title: Reports Humans Will Read
features.description: A tidy PDF with annotated stills, severity ratings, and location tags. No dashboards. No 'synergy.' Just what's wrong and how bad.

features.title: Works With Your Cheap Drone
features.description: Mavic, Mini, that off-brand one you regret. If it shoots 1080p, we'll process it. No enterprise sensor rig required.

features.title: Before-And-After Memory
features.description: We keep every inspection so you can prove the crack grew, or that it absolutely didn't, next time a contractor gets creative.

features.title: Geotagged Defect Map
features.description: Every flag pinned to a location on your structure, so 'the northeast gutter' means something to more than just you.

features.title: Export Without Begging
features.description: Download the raw stills, the report, and a CSV of every defect. It's your roof. Take your data and go.

testimonials.quote: I priced a professional roof inspection at $475. I flew my $300 drone, uploaded it, and had a report before the coffee finished brewing. The insurer accepted it. Absurd.
testimonials.name: Dara Whitlock

testimonials.quote: I inspect solar arrays part-time. Vulture Deck flagged three cracked panels I'd have missed and didn't try to upsell me a 'platform.' Rare.
testimonials.name: Miguel Ferreira

testimonials.quote: We manage forty rural cell towers on a budget that would embarrass a lemonade stand. This replaced the spreadsheet-and-prayer system. Nobody's fallen off anything since.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
